name: zoon/puphpeteer
description: A PHP client running Puppeteer in embedded QuickJS.

scripts-descriptions.test: Run all PHP/JS functional tests, local browser examples, Psalm, generated API and bundle checks. Requires QuickJS, Chrome and npm; no load test or benchmark.
scripts-descriptions.test-release: Run composer test, then browser load checks (default: --cycles=50 --timeout=600 seconds). No benchmark.
scripts-descriptions.psalm: Static PHP type analysis only; no tests, QuickJS extension or Chrome required.
scripts-descriptions.benchmark: Measure browser-call latency, client CPU and RSS; defaults: --trials=5 --iterations=1000. Requires QuickJS and Chrome.
scripts-descriptions.build: Rebuild the committed QuickJS JavaScript bundles from installed npm dependencies.
scripts-descriptions.browser:install: Install the Chrome version pinned in upstream/lock.json; requires PHP HTTPS streams and unzip; respects PUPPETEER_CACHE_DIR and download-skip flags.
scripts-descriptions.update-php: Regenerate PHP API wrappers, compatibility aliases and README version badges from installed Puppeteer.
scripts-descriptions.verify-php: Check generated PHP API, aliases and version badges without changing files.
